reuse.why: Follows getUpcomingDates' shape and reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, getDateWithSkippedWeekend and the breadcrumb handling; the daily-weekend skip has no shared helper and is re-derived inline.

duplication.why: The 'daily schedules drop weekend occurrences' condition (frequency === 'daily' && skipWeekend && isWeekend) repeats what getNextDate in shared/schedules.ts already decides.

placement.why: The handler sits beside getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered the same way, though the daily/weekend rule itself lives in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Readable, but the hard-coded two-day search margin and the second copy of the daily-weekend rule must be kept in step with the shared weekend logic by hand.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The weekend shift goes through getDateWithSkippedWeekend; no helper existed for the daily skip.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily-weekend condition in getDatesInRange is an open restatement of getNextDate's condition, not reshaped to hide it.
